purpose: Worldwide source registry for identifying complete PDFs, digitized manuscripts, and public-domain/open copies of works within the 1-400 AH target. Discovery never implies redistribution rights.

sources.name: Arabic Collections Online
sources.rights_rule: ACO states its Arabic content is public domain; retain item metadata and verify exact edition

sources.name: Smithsonian Libraries Digital Library
sources.use: Arabic/Islamic manuscript PDF and image acquisition
sources.rights_rule: use only item records explicitly marked CC0/Public Domain or otherwise permitted

sources.name: Arabic Wikisource
sources.use: public-domain scans/text and PDF file discovery

sources.name: Princeton University Library — Manuscripts of the Islamic World
sources.rights_rule: Princeton describes the digital resource as free/open for academic and research use; check item-specific terms before redistribution

sources.name: Kairawan Global Arabic & Islamic Manuscript Index
sources.use: cross-library manuscript discovery and source resolution
sources.rights_rule: follow record to holding institution and apply its rights

sources.name: BnF Gallica
sources.use: Arabic manuscripts and heritage print discovery

sources.name: Fihrist / Bodleian
sources.use: Arabic manuscript discovery and holding-library resolution

sources.name: Al-Furqan Digital Library
sources.rights_rule: do not infer redistribution rights from access

sources.name: Google Books
sources.rights_rule: only acquire files when access/rights permit

sources.name: Open Library
sources.use: edition/work and Internet Archive identifier resolution
sources.rights_rule: do not treat metadata as download permission

confirmed_global_facts.nyu_aco: ACO currently exposes 17,698 volumes and states its Arabic content is public domain; individual pages provide low/high-resolution PDF downloads.
confirmed_global_facts.kairawan: Kairawan reports 241,236 searchable Arabic/Islamic manuscripts across major international collections as of 2026-09-04 and links records to the holding library.
confirmed_global_facts.smithsonian: Qualifying Smithsonian Arabic manuscript records explicitly marked CC0/Public Domain provide PDF/ePub/image downloads.
confirmed_global_facts.princeton: Princeton's Manuscripts of the Islamic World collection contains digitized Islamic manuscripts and states the digital resource is free/open for academic and research purposes.

required_workflow: For every catalogued work in 1-400H: search all applicable global sources, resolve exact title/author/work identity, prefer complete digital surrogate, download actual bytes when permitted, validate PDF, hash, encrypt for review, and publish only when redistribution rights are verified.
